title: Elite Status Extension
scenario: An email says your elite status can be extended if you update your details through a button.

answers.A: Update your details through the button before the offer closes.
answers.B: Open your loyalty account directly and check the status notice.
answers.C: Call the loyalty programme using its official website.
answers.D: Ask the email sender to send the offer again from another address.

explanation: Status extensions belong in the loyalty account. A button that requests fresh personal data may lead to a fake sign-in page.
proTip: Never sign in through an unexpected loyalty email.
